```{r results='hide'}
library(txdbmaker)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(tximport)
library(DESeq2)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
#Build tx2gene df
txdb <- makeTxDbFromGFF("../RawReads/Arabidopsis_thaliana.TAIR10.62.gff3.gz")

# seqlevels(txdb)
# columns(txdb)
# keytypes(txdb)

all_keys = keys(txdb, keytype = "TXNAME")

tx2gene <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  txdb,
  keys = all_keys,
  columns = "GENEID",
  keytype = "TXNAME")

tx2gene <- tx2gene %>% unique()
```

```{r}
base_path = "../RawReads/BulkRNAseq/fastp_out/salmon_out/"
file_extension = "/quant.sf"

quant_sf <- c(
  LD_ZT02=paste0(base_path, "SRR10148637", file_extension),

  LD_ZT20=paste0(base_path, "SRR10148643", file_extension),
  LD_ZT23=paste0(base_path, "SRR10148644", file_extension),
  LD_ZT26=paste0(base_path, "SRR10148645", file_extension),

head(txi$abundance)
```

```{r}
colData <- data.frame(
  row.names = colnames(txi$counts),
  timepoint = factor(colnames(txi$counts))
)

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromTximport(txi, colData, design = ~1)
dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)
normalized_counts <- counts(dds, normalized = TRUE)
VST_counts <- vst(dds)
VST_matrix <- assay(VST_counts)
```

Convert to dataframe
```{r}
normalized_counts_df <- data.frame(normalized_counts) %>% rownames_to_column("GeneID")
VST_df <- data.frame(VST_matrix) %>% rownames_to_column("GeneID")
```



```{r}
#Add mean and log_mean from TPM
#First match TPM to normalized_counts_df
TPM <- data.frame(txi$abundance)
TPM <- TPM[normalized_counts_df$GeneID, ]
normalized_counts_df <- normalized_counts_df %>%
  mutate(mean_count = rowMeans(normalized_counts_df %>% select(!GeneID))) %>%
  mutate(mean_TPM = rowMeans(TPM)) %>%
  mutate(log_TPM = log10(mean_TPM))

ggplot(data = normalized_counts_df, aes(y = log_TPM)) +
  geom_boxplot()
hist(normalized_counts_df$log_TPM)
quantile(normalized_counts_df$mean_count, probs = c(0.05, 0.10, 0.25, 0.75, 0.90, 0.95))

# Drop genes with average gene count less than 5
normalized_counts_df <- normalized_counts_df %>% filter(mean_count >= 5)
idx <- match(normalized_counts_df$GeneID, VST_df$GeneID)
stopifnot(!anyNA(idx))
VST_df <- VST_df[idx, , drop = FALSE]
rownames(VST_df) <- NULL
nrow(normalized_counts_df) #19215

hist(normalized_counts_df$log_TPM)
```

```{r}
#Save out normalized_counts with low read counts removed
# Drop columns no longer needed for downstream
normalized_counts_df <- normalized_counts_df %>% select(-mean_count, -mean_TPM)
write_csv(normalized_counts_df, "../Processed_Data/Normalized_counts.csv")

#Also save out VST normalized counts
write_csv(VST_df, "../Processed_Data/VST.csv")
```

```{r}
circadian <- c("AT1G01060", "AT2G46830", "AT5G61380")
set.seed(123)
random_int <- sample(1:nrow(normalized_counts_df), 3)
random <- normalized_counts_df$GeneID[random_int]

# Pull a set of genes as a named numeric vector
gene_counts_df <- normalized_counts_df %>%
  select(!c(log_TPM)) %>%
  filter(GeneID %in% c(random, circadian)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    starts_with("LD_"), 
    values_to = "counts", 
    names_to = "timepoint") %>% 
  mutate(
    category = ifelse(GeneID %in% circadian, "Circadian", "Random"),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = colnames(normalized_counts_df %>% select(starts_with("LD_")))),
    GeneID = factor(GeneID, levels = c(circadian, random)))


ggplot(gene_counts_df, aes(x = timepoint, y = counts)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = category), size = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(color = category, group = GeneID), linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~GeneID, nrow = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Circadian" = "#E76F51", "Random" = "#457B9D")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
    strip.text   = element_text(face = "italic"),
    legend.title = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(x = "Timepoint", y = "Normalized counts",
       title = "Circadian vs random genes")
```
